topics.title: BI 3000202 (cGASi) SLE Ph2 (1509-0004) – China Integration & CTA Submission

background.text: CDE clinical division (Jul 25, 2025): China joining global Ph2 MRCT is reasonable. CDE clin-pharm division (Aug 20, 2025): agree with China joining global Ph2 clinical trial. CDE agreed to backloading PK trial to join Ph2 study (Aug 2025). Integration strategy endorsed.
background.quote:
Clinical division: July 25th 2025
Based on the briefing document, China join the global phase II MRCT is reasonable. | Clin-pharm division: Aug 20th 2025
Agree with China join the global Phase II clinical trial.

background.text: F2F visit to leading PI Mengtao Li and sub-I on Nov 10 for communications on final protocol, study plan and 30WD CTA process. Package for 30WD CTA submission in preparation, targeting submission to CDE in Jan 2026.
background.quote:
CDE agreed to  backloading PK trial to join Ph 2 study in Aug 2025.
F2F visit to leading PI – Mengtao Li and sub-I on 10th Nov., for communications on final protocol, study plan and 30WD CTA process.
Package for 30WD CTA  submission in preparation, targeting submission to CDE in Jan2026.

corrected.detail: 原稿 background 中「Integration strategy endorsed」措辞含糊，可能被误读为委员会背书决议。原文来源为 Slide 43 表格 Status 列，属于进度状态描述，非 PEC/CEC 决议，已保留在 background 并注明来源，不移入 decision。
todo 原稿缺少 owner、status 和 completed 字段。已补充：owner 原文未说明；status: in preparation；completed: N。
F2F visit（Nov 10）已发生，属已完成执行步骤，不构成待办行动，已移入 background 而非 todo，避免将已完成事项写成未完成。
for_endorsement 为空：原文无明确提交 PEC/CEC 委员会的背书请求，不从 decision 反推。decision 为空：原文无 PEC/CEC 层级决议记录，CDE 意见属监管机构反馈，不计入 decision。

not_applicable.detail: 本议题无 PEC/CEC/TA-CEC 等委员会决议，委员会来源层级检查不适用。

coverage: 两个原始证据 chunk 均已引用：chunk-30c485f9769e 覆盖 CDE backloading 同意、PI 访问、CTA 准备进度及 Jan 2026 提交目标；chunk-257def2cd1a9 覆盖 CDE 临床及临床药理部门的两次正式反馈。其余 evidence_markdown 片段均属其他资产（Nerandomilast 等），与本议题无关，未引入。
unresolved: 「Integration strategy endorsed」原文为表格 Status 列文字，背书主体（PEC/CEC 或其他）原文未说明，无法确认是否为委员会决议。
